text: This policy governs the replacement of physical SIM cards and the transfer of eSIMs for both consumer and business lines. It applies to transactions conducted at GCT retail stores, the call centre and all digital channels.

text: Staff must verify the original identity document presented by the customer before initiating any SIM replacement. In addition, verification requires a one-time passcode sent to the registered email.
